title: He held it in so hard, something tore 😳
caption:
Just let it out. Seriously. 🤧
Tag the one who holds in sneezes 👇
sources: Yang W. et al. (2018) 'Spontaneous perforation of the pharynx: holding in a sneeze', BMJ Case Reports, bcr-2017-223014 (34-year-old man, Leicester; 7 days in hospital, tube-fed)
Mistry R. K. et al. (2024) 'Snap, crackle and pop: when sneezing leads to tracheal rupture', BMJ Case Reports (Dundee case)
